verdict.rationale: The app lets users add MCP servers (and skills) from a Library in Settings, and every model sees them. That is a generic extension path through which workflow tools could plausibly be connected to give the agent more context. However, the evidence never names Jira, Slack, Google Drive or any prebuilt connectors, so the story is only delivered indirectly through a generic mechanism. Missing for 10: named first-party integrations or Library entries for Jira, Slack and Google Drive, documentation of how such connectors are configured and authenticated, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
